--- original

@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01KYD3V73Z3DP0QPQZGSEVE4R0
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8d80
+title: 'ACPTunnelTransport + elicitation: the unstable-schema surface (gated, follow-up)'
+---
+## What
+
+Plan §8 (elicitation) and §8.7 (the ACP tunnel). **Filed 2026-07-26** to hold the work the plan describes in detail but which is **not in stable ACP v2** — split out of the MCP task (seve4r0) and the conformance (gsebt3m) so neither is blocked on an unstable surface.
+
+Verified against the vendored schemas: `acp-v2.meta.json` (stable) contains `initialize`, `auth/login`, `auth/logout`, `session/new`, `session/resume`, `session/list`, `session/delete`, `session/close`, `session/prompt`, `session/cancel`, `session/set_config_option`, `session/request_permission`, `session/update`. **`acp-v2.meta.unstable.json` additionally** contains `elicitation/create`, `elicitation/complete`, `mcp/connect`, `mcp/message`, `mcp/disconnect`, and `session/fork` — all method names only, no generated payload types, no handlers.
+
+## Why it is gated, not merely unimplemented
+
+- No stable-v2 capability advertises a tunnel, so a stable-only client can never ask for one.
+- Stable `ClientCapabilities` carries **only `_meta`** — so the `clientCapabilities.elicitation` gate §8 describes does not exist in stable v2. Elicitation support must be `_meta`-negotiated, and *absent* must be treated as *unsupported*.
+- The payload shapes may change before these graduate. Building against them now risks rework.
+
+## Work
+
+**1. `ACPTunnelTransport`** — `mcp/connect` + `mcp/message` (bidirectional) + `mcp/disconnect`, where the client hosts the MCP server and the agent tunnels MCP JSON-RPC over ACP. It belongs in **this** package: it is an `MCP.Transport` conformance needing ACP types, and `FoundationModelsMCP` must never depend on `FoundationModelsACP`. Plugs into that package's transport factory like any other transport. In tunnel mode the client owns the processes, so `StdioServerProcess` is bypassed entirely. **Blocked on** the wire package generating/vendoring the `mcp/*` payload types.
+
+**2. `ACPElicitationCoordinator: ElicitationCoordinator`** (§8) — the relay, holding the `AgentSideConnection`. `elicit` → `elicitation/create`; `complete(elicitationId:)` → `elicitation/complete`. MCP and ACP elicitation are near-isomorphic, which is what makes it cheap. Requirements from §8, unchanged except the capability gate:
+- Scope every request: `sessionId` (optionally with `toolCallId`) or a `requestId` outside a session. Map the MCP call handle → `toolCallId` so the client can show *which* call is asking — including a detached, long-running one.
+- Gate on `_meta`-advertised support; treat absent as unsupported. Never request an unsupported mode (`-32602`). When unsupported, return MCP `decline` with a clear reason — never a lossy squeeze into `session/request_permission`, which is options-based (`[PermissionOption]` + `subject`) and cannot carry a `requestedSchema`.
+- Relay URL-mode completion: create → accept → `elicitation/complete { elicitationId }`; forward MCP's `notifications/elicitation/complete` straight through, ids match by design.
+- Honor the security duties: form mode MUST NOT request secrets; URL-mode credentials MUST NOT come back over ACP; verify the authenticated user identity matches between initiation and completion; HTTPS outside development; no prefetching.
+- Do not stall the model: wrap the round-trip in Router's `awaitingUser { }` to release the per-model generation gate — this package is the right caller because it is the one place that knows both "I am about to block on a person" and "Router holds the gate."
+- **Emit `requires_action`** on entering the round-trip and `running` on the answer (§9.1). The `awaitingUser` release and the `state_update` transition are two halves of one action; a client seeing `running` while we silently wait on a person renders a hung agent.
+
+**3. Interim fallback (do this part NOW, not gated).** `FoundationModelsMCP`'s `ElicitationCoordinator` needs a non-ACP implementation so the `mcp` built-in (§7.1) is not blocked: a coordinator that **declines every elicitation** with a clear "this host cannot ask you questions yet" reason. Honest, small, and it unblocks day one.
+
+**4. `session/fork`** — note only. Router already forks sessions, so if this graduates it is a cheap win rather than new machinery. Do not build against the unstable schema.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] The declining fallback coordinator ships and the `mcp` built-in works without any ACP elicitation support.
+- [ ] Gated behind the unstable schema: nothing in the stable code path references `elicitation/*` or `mcp/*`.
+- [ ] When the wire package generates the types: `ACPTunnelTransport` conforms to `MCP.Transport` and works through the factory.
+- [ ] A tunneled server completes initialize + tools/list + tools/call over `mcp/message`.
+- [ ] Elicitation form and URL modes relay end to end, with `requires_action`/`running` bracketing and the per-model gate released.
+- [ ] Absent `_meta` elicitation support ⇒ decline with a reason, never a permission-request substitution.
+
+## Workflow
+
+- Use `/tdd`.
\ No newline at end of file
